items.title: Can Bank of America (BAC) Still Be Undervalued Here?
items.summary: Bank of America has pulled back in the short term yet still carries a sizeable 3 year return, so the real question for you is whether the price now fairly reflects the returns the bank earns on its capital. Over the past 3 years the share price has gained 83.8%, which puts recent weakness in context and raises the issue of whether that earlier value creation is still being priced into the stock.
